documents.page_convention: printed page N = physical PDF page N+1
documents.authority_scope: Pinned official manual only; latest Q&A, communications protocol, referee firmware, and construction manual not newly verified.

limitations: Only a partial parameter projection into the unchanged synthetic roster engine. These rows are not implemented official robot classes or faithful playable roles.
Only max_hp and explicitly listed infantry base 17 mm heat parameters are sourced. Every other engine input must be an explicitly supplied synthetic assumption.
Native initial HP equals selected max_hp and heat starts at zero. This is an experimental fixture initialization, not an official full-heal, match-start or mid-match-state rule.
All movement, projectile velocity/damage/cadence, circle geometry, sensor range, ammunition, spawning, team counts and eligibility remain synthetic.
Heavy and sentry rows are HP-only inputs. They do not implement 42 mm weapons, assembly phases, resources, posture, control-mode compliance or other class behavior.
Legacy Hero and Engineer are not separate 2027 roles and are not silently aliased to Heavy. Aerial, hangar, dart and radar systems have no selectable supported projection.
Source heat values do not choose an equality policy or change the existing synthetic heat scheduler. Disabled heat leaves the parameters configured but inactive.
The catalog does not implement official armor detection, buffs, upgrades, healing, revival, allowed-shot accounting, power limits or official field dimensions.
The pinned V1.0.0 manual is the source authority for these values. Latest official Q&A, construction rules, firmware and communications behavior are not certified.
The catalog and checksums provide reproducible provenance, not cryptographic authenticity or proof of controller behavior.
max_hp is not current_hp. Higher-level/phase fixtures may deliberately initialize full HP but must call that experimental. No upgrade full heal is sourced.
Only infantry level1 is documented at match start. The40 presets are static selectable numeric snapshots; no XP or level-transition simulator.
Do not apply base30/10 as default effective cooling. Auto unbuffed movement computes10; semi-auto computes10/3 before unspecified integer policy. HP-only deliberately excludes both Q0 and cooling.
600-HP row is third assembly OR successful42mm installation, not both. Static row selection does not implement unlock or phase transition.
Q1=Q0+100 permanent lock conflicts between prose> and flowchart>=; catalog constants cannot resolve it. Preserve existing explicit heat policy and provenance.

10Hz source settlement and tentative/native scheduler phase/event order are distinct. Base cooling C heat/s converts to C heat-tenths per100ms. Do not change heat module scheduling from catalog selection.
Infantry C values are base rates. External buffs and changes are excluded; source greatest-effect selection is not additive stacking.
PinnedV1.0.0 only. No latest official Q&A/construction manual/firmware certification.
Do not edit native roster source pin/config grammar/raw replay. Resolved numeric native configs require provenance-bearing outer wrappers; exported native config alone loses catalog claims.
